<details><summary>What the change connects to (5 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Show in Finder / drag out from the Library's Ready to upload card (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:80`) — The card, the chip and the outline stay after the user acted on the copy. If it fails: revealLocalRecording's promise is voided in both places, so a failure is silent in both. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:278-295`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:10-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:76-94`.
- Retire the Ready cards when the route leaves the Library (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:99-103`) — On the next visit the cards are gone and the regular card shows the outline. If it fails: In list view the cards never render, yet leaving still retires them (a stated design decision). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:92-106`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:97-100`.
- Minimized widget state read from sessionStorage (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-18`) — On a read error the widget opens expanded. If it fails: An unreadable store only means expanded; nothing is overwritten except by the user's own toggle, so no data is lost. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-35`.
- New ICU select keys (progressTitle, readyTitle, pill, dragTo, destinationTag) are fed with the job's destination, or "export" / "other" when it has none (`packages/i18n/messages/en.json:1413`) — The progress widget title, the pill label, the ready toast title, the drag button and the poster tag. An editor export (destination null) goes to `other` ("Exporting your video", "Drag to upload"). The archive tag falls to `other` ("Archive copy"). If it fails: A destination id with no branch falls through to `other`. All six current DESTINATION_IDS are covered. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:62-64`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:141`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:223`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:298`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:97`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destination-tag.tsx:19`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36-43`.
- The export cards move into a new bottom-right fixed stack with pointer-events: none (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-stack.module.css:19`) — The widget, pill and ready toast sit 40px above the bottom, at right 16px, z-index 40, below modals. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-stack.tsx:24-29`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-card.module.css:5`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.module.css:77`.

</details>

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** I found one fix in part 1. The new Library "Ready to upload" card skips a step the ready toast takes. On the toast, Show in Finder and the drag both call `markCopySeen` first; on the new card they don't. So after the user reveals the copy or drags it out of the Library, the card, the "1 copy ready" chip and the outline all stay.

I also have one test note: the library-page test "opening the copy goes to its page and forgets it" checks only the new page, never that the copy is forgotten.

The rest checks out:

- **Fingerprint fix:** `copyPresetOf` compares only the part before "#", which fixes how "Copies from this master" recognises copies. The panel now uses it.
- **Minimized widget:** the state's sessionStorage handling falls back safely and never overwrites stored data.
- **Retiring cards:** the route watch in the sidebar is correct, including under StrictMode.

The PR body's email wording ("Exporting for email", FOR EMAIL) is not in the head's `en.json` or `DestinationId`. That fits the stacked-branch note in the body.

**Batch 2 of 2.** Part 2 covers the stylesheets, docs and messages. I found nothing that blocks the merge.

- **Stylesheets.** They hold up against the code:
  - every CSS variable they use is defined elsewhere in the app;
  - the two-column `span 2` fits the Library grid, which is always 3 columns (`repeat(3, 1fr)`) with no media query;
  - the new bottom-right stack keeps the widget, pill and toast clickable, because each sets `pointer-events: auto`.
- **Messages.** The removed keys `hide` and `readyDragToUpload` are no longer referenced anywhere. Every new ICU select covers all six current destinations or falls through to `other`. en.json and es.json match key for key.

Two notes:

- **Doc QA order.** Step 7 of the validation steps in `ready-copy-in-library.md` lists the two cards oldest first, which contradicts "newest first" (consider).
- **PR body.** The body's "Email wording" bullet is not in this commit: none of the selects has an `email` branch, and `DESTINATION_IDS` has no `email` (info).

</details>

<details><summary>Details of findings with no thread (1)</summary>

**The PR body's "Email wording" is not in this code (confidence high)** ([`en.json:1413`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/e45c845143ba72f35fea4fac2f9d62a186dff986/packages/i18n/messages/en.json#L1413))

The PR body says email "gets its own text: 'Exporting for email', 'Email copy ready', 'Drag to an email' and a FOR EMAIL tag". None of the `backgroundCopy` selects (`progressTitle`, `readyTitle`, `pill`, `dragTo`, `destinationTag`) has an `email` branch, in en.json or es.json. `DESTINATION_IDS` at this head also has no `email` (apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36-43). So the strings are consistent with the code, but the body describes a merge that is not in this commit. If email lands from #467, every one of these selects will fall through to `other` ("Exporting your video", "Archive copy" tag) unless a branch is added.

</details>
